description: This file defines the class MessageHeaderTimeoutValueValidator, a final immutable class that validates header values intended to represent timeout durations as seconds in the context of message handling. It extends an abstract header value validator and provides mechanisms to parse and validate timeout values, throwing exceptions if validation fails.

classes.name: MessageHeaderTimeoutValueValidator
classes.description: A final, immutable class that validates message header timeout values, ensuring they can be parsed to a long and represent a valid duration of seconds.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the validator for use in validation processes.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the header value by attempting to parse it into a long and then into a Duration. Throws an exception if parsing fails.

methods.name: parseLong
methods.description: Converts the CharSequence value to a long, assuming prior validation has confirmed its format.
